title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #20 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the shikhara? (1 mark)
   A. The floor
   B. The bell
   C. The spire above the inner room
   D. The kitchen

2. In which Kenyan towns are Mandirs found? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu
   B. Only in villages
   C. None
   D. Only Lamu

3. What is prasad? (1 mark)
   A. A garden
   B. Blessed food shared after prayers
   C. A kind of shoe
   D. A prayer book

4. Which is the first line of the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   B. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   D. Om Namah Shivaya

5. What does the Gayatri Mantra ask for? (1 mark)
   A. Wisdom
   B. A big house
   C. Rain
   D. Money

6. From which Veda does the Gayatri Mantra come? (1 mark)
   A. Rig Veda
   B. Atharva Veda only
   C. Ramayan
   D. Dhammapada

7. When can Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva be said? (1 mark)
   A. Only at a wedding
   B. Before meals and in the evening
   C. Only at a funeral
   D. Never

8. What does the veena stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. War
   C. Rain
   D. Music and the arts

9. Why is integrity compared to a strong wall? (1 mark)
   A. Because it is heavy
   B. Because it is tall
   C. Because walls are white
   D. One weak brick can make it fall

10. What is the purpose of a lost and found corner? (1 mark)
   A. To keep found items until owners claim them
   B. To keep the items forever
   C. To hide them
   D. To sell lost items

11. What should Amina do about the extra money? (1 mark)
   A. Spend it
   B. Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   C. Give it away
   D. Keep it

12. What should passengers do with rubbish? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it on the seat
   B. Drop it on the road
   C. Keep it until you find a bin
   D. Throw it out of the window

13. Who should be allowed to board first? (1 mark)
   A. Children, elders and people with disabilities
   B. The fastest
   C. The loudest
   D. The strongest

14. In Bhastrika, how is the breath done? (1 mark)
   A. Only in
   B. In and out with equal strength
   C. Not at all
   D. Only out

15. When should you practise yoga? (1 mark)
   A. While running
   B. Right after a big meal
   C. When your stomach is not full
   D. While eating

16. What should you practise yoga on? (1 mark)
   A. A mat
   B. A tree
   C. A road
   D. A wet floor

17. Which pose is called the hare or moon pose? (1 mark)
   A. Kapaal Bhaati
   B. Sasankasana
   C. Vajra Asana
   D. Bhastrika

18. In Kapaal Bhaati, which part of the breath is quick? (1 mark)
   A. Both are held
   B. The breath out
   C. The breath in
   D. Neither

19. What is the correct way to sit for Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Standing on one leg
   B. Lying on the stomach
   C. Slouching
   D. With a straight back and relaxed body

20. What does Kapaal Bhaati mean? (1 mark)
   A. Moon pose
   B. Shining forehead
   C. Sitting pose
   D. Diamond pose

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how you can show integrity when using the internet. (3 marks)

22. Describe how to sit in Vajra Asana. (3 marks)

23. Write three signs of integrity at school. (3 marks)

24. Draw and label a simple Mandir. Name four features you would show. (4 marks)

25. What is the role of the bell in a Mandir? (2 marks)

26. Explain why respect for a Mandir is important and how a visitor of any faith can show it. (5 marks)

27. Explain how learners can include friends with special needs in yoga. (5 marks)

28. Name two things a lost and found corner needs. (2 marks)

29. Give three activities to learn about temples. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — The spire above the inner room
   It is the spire or dome.

2. A — Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu
   Mandirs are found in many Kenyan towns.

3. B — Blessed food shared after prayers
   Prasad is blessed food.

4. B — Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   The Gayatri Mantra begins Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah.

5. A — Wisdom
   It asks that the divine light guide our minds.

6. A — Rig Veda
   The Gayatri Mantra comes from the Rig Veda.

7. B — Before meals and in the evening
   It is said before meals, at assembly and in the evening.

8. D — Music and the arts
   It is a musical instrument.

9. D — One weak brick can make it fall
   Small lies can weaken trust.

10. A — To keep found items until owners claim them
   Owners can claim their things.

11. B — Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   Integrity means giving it back.

12. C — Keep it until you find a bin
   Keeping the environment clean is good conduct.

13. A — Children, elders and people with disabilities
   We care for those who need help.

14. B — In and out with equal strength
   Breathing is equal, like a bellows.

15. C — When your stomach is not full
   Do it with an empty stomach.

16. A — A mat
   A clean mat is best.

17. B — Sasankasana
   Sasankasana.

18. B — The breath out
   The breath is pushed out in short pulls.

19. D — With a straight back and relaxed body
   A straight back helps breathing.

20. B — Shining forehead
   Kapaal is forehead and bhaati is shining.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission before using a device, do not copy another's work, do not send unkind or untrue messages, and keep personal details private (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kneel with knees together, bring big toes close, sit back on your heels, keep the back and head straight and place palms on the thighs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three correct steps.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Not cheating, owning up to mistakes, handing in lost items, telling the truth, doing your own work (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hall, a spire, a door with steps, a bell or flag, and the murti room (any four labelled).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct feature labelled.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Worshippers ring it gently to announce that they have arrived.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for ringing, 1 mark for announcing arrival.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: A Mandir is a holy place. Visitors can remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, ask before photos and accept prasad politely. Respect brings peace among faiths.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for holy place, 3 marks for three ways, 1 mark for peace.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: They can do breathing slowly, take seated poses, help hold the chart or take photos, and be encouraged by their partners. Everyone's effort is respected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points and 1 mark for respect.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: A box or table for found items and a book to record the date and finder (any two sensible items).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make a collage of temple pictures, map Mandirs on a sketch map or digital map, draw and colour a Mandir, visit one with permission (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
